description: Basecamp agent hooks: session context and commit-reference nudges.

hooks.command: command -v basecamp >/dev/null 2>&1 || { d="$(mise which basecamp 2>/dev/null)" && PATH="${d%/*}:$PATH"; }; command -v basecamp >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec basecamp agent-hook session-start || true
